allow: PowerShell($out = @\(\); foreach \($c in @\('go','node','npm','docker','psql'\)\) { $cmd = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($null -ne $cmd\) { $v = & $c --version 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1; $out += "$c :: $v" } else { $out += "$c :: NAO ENCONTRADO" } }; $out)

PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\Go\\bin\\go.exe", "${env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)}\\Go\\bin\\go.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Go\\bin\\go.exe", "$env:USERPROFILE\\go\\bin\\go.exe", "$env:USERPROFILE\\scoop\\shims\\go.exe", "C:\\Go\\bin\\go.exe"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { "ENCONTRADO: $p" } }; "--- winget/choco go? ---"; if \(Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "winget disponivel" } else { "winget ausente" }; if \(Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "choco disponivel" } else { "choco ausente" }; "--- docker desktop? ---"; if \(Test-Path "$env:ProgramFiles\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe"\) { "docker desktop instalado \(fora do PATH\)" } else { "docker desktop ausente" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Instalando Go ==="; winget install --id GoLang.Go --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --silent --disable-interactivity; Write-Output "=== Go exit: $LASTEXITCODE ==="; Write-Output "=== Instalando PostgreSQL 17 ==="; winget install --id PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL.17 --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --silent --disable-interactivity --custom '--unattendedmodeui none --superpassword synergy_dev_pw --serverport 5432'; Write-Output "=== PG exit: $LASTEXITCODE ===")
